scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @affiliateos/api" "npm run dev --workspace @affiliateos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @affiliateos/api && npm run build --workspace @affiliateos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
